verdict.rationale: Google documents data residency for Gemini model usage: data at rest stays in the customer-selected location, and the processing location follows the chosen regional or jurisdictional endpoint. This is documented for the Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform surface, not the ai.google.dev Gemini API itself, and global endpoints carry no residency guarantee. missing for 10: residency controls documented for the ai.google.dev Gemini API surface, a list of selectable regions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Data stored at rest in the customer selected location remains at rest in that location, independent of the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform endpoint called by that customer's request.
The geographic location of this processing is determined by your choice of endpoint
